label: 6 November 2026
title: Squad trains on day off before Atlético; Raphinha reassures on Brazil
deck: Around 14 players, including Yamal and Pedri, reported to the Ciutat Esportiva despite Flick’s rest day. Raphinha said he has spoken to Ancelotti about minutes. Shkodran Mustafi watched training.

stories.headline: Yamal, Pedri and others train on Flick’s day off
stories.summary: Hansi Flick gave the squad a rest day three days before the trip to Atlético Madrid. Around 14 players still went to the Ciutat Esportiva Joan Gamper. Goalkeepers Joan García, Szczesny and Livaković, plus Gavi, Pedri, Lamine Yamal and Cancelo were among those who reported for gym work or individual sessions.
stories.body: Mundo Deportivo reported that the injured group also attended: Espart, Olmo, Bardghji, Christensen, Koundé, Eric García and the newly sidelined Rodri. The club said the available players came for management tasks, consultations and gym work. The next competitive match is Sunday 8 November at 21:00 at the Metropolitano. Barça lead La Liga by two points. Flick is expected to name a squad without Rodri, who has a minor right hamstring injury and will miss the match. The voluntary turnout follows the 3-0 Champions League win over Aston Villa on Tuesday.

tweets.name: Barça Universal
tweets.text: Around 14 Barcelona players showed up at the Ciutat Esportiva TODAY despite Hansi Flick giving the squad a day off! Joan García, Szczęsny, Livaković, Gavi, Pedri, Lamine Yamal and Cancelo all visited the facilities.

stories.headline: Raphinha tells fans not to worry about Brazil minutes
stories.summary: Raphinha said at his contract signing that he has spoken with Carlo Ancelotti. The Brazil coach knows he must manage minutes. The Barcelona captain is still recovering from his last injury and is not at 100 per cent.
stories.body: MARCA reported the comments from the ceremony at Spotify Camp Nou. Raphinha, who signed until 30 June 2030, has scored 19 goals in 13 matches this season. He told the media that Ancelotti understands the situation. He added that he takes care of himself and that culés should not be concerned. The Brazilian is expected to be called up for friendlies against Japan and Singapore during the November window. His availability for club matches after the break will depend on how his recovery progresses and how Ancelotti uses him.

stories.headline: Mustafi watches Barça training after Flick invitation
stories.summary: Shkodran Mustafi, the 2014 World Cup winner, visited the Ciutat Esportiva. He is now assistant coach of Germany’s under-21 side. SPORT reported that Hansi Flick invited him to observe a first-team session.
stories.body: Carlos Monfort of SPORT first reported the visit. Mustafi was welcomed by assistant coach Marcus Sorg, with whom he has a long relationship from their time in German football. He had previously watched the Youth League match against Aston Villa at Camp Nou. The 34-year-old is studying coaching methods. No formal role has been announced. The session he attended was part of the preparation for Sunday’s La Liga match at Atlético Madrid.

tweets.name: Barça Universal
tweets.text: Former Arsenal and Valencia defender Shkodran Mustafi visited Barcelona's training facilities to learn from Hansi Flick! The 2014 World Cup winner, now assistant coach of Germany's U21 national team, was personally invited by Flick.

stories.headline: Barça reach 60 goals in 15 games, highest rate in a century
stories.summary: The three goals against Aston Villa took Barcelona to 60 goals in 15 matches this season. The club said the figure has not been matched in a century. The average is four goals per game.
stories.body: FC Barcelona published the comparison on its official site. The last similar numbers came in 1926-27 under Jack Domby and Romà Forns, when the side scored 69 goals in its first 15 competitive matches of that campaign. Those matches were mainly in the Catalan championship. Raphinha and Lamine Yamal have led the scoring this season. Raphinha has 19 goals. The side have scored in every competitive match so far. The Villa win also gave them a clean sheet in the Champions League for the first time in 18 matches.

stories.headline: Seven Barça players called up to Spain U17 World Cup squad
stories.summary: Spain named seven Barcelona players in its under-17 squad for the 2026 FIFA U-17 World Cup in Qatar. The tournament runs from 19 November to 13 December.
stories.body: The list includes Ebrima Tunkara, Jordi Pesquer, Raúl Expósito, Sergi Mayans, Baba Kouroma, Roberto Tomás and Iu Martínez. BarçaTimes reported the official call-up. Several of the players have featured with the first-team squad or Barça Atlètic this season. The call-ups come during the November international window. Spain will play in Qatar while the senior side faces Czechia and England in the Nations League.

tweets.name: BarçaTimes
tweets.text: OFFICIAL: Seven Barcelona players have been called up to Spain’s U17 squad for the 2026 FIFA U-17 World Cup.

stories.headline: Atlético recovers Cardoso; only Romero remains out
stories.summary: Johnny Cardoso trained with the Atlético Madrid group on Thursday. He is available for Sunday’s match against Barcelona. Cristian Romero is the only senior absentee for Diego Simeone’s side.
stories.body: AS and SPORT reported that Cardoso completed the session at Majadahonda after missing recent matches with a thigh injury. Pablo Barrios and Morten Hjulmand are also available. Atlético have seven straight La Liga wins. They sit two points behind Barcelona. The Metropolitano hosts the match at 21:00. Barça will travel without Rodri and with several senior defenders still unavailable. Simeone can choose from his full midfield options.

stories.headline: La Liga and clubs to honour Jesús de Miguel this weekend
stories.summary: Spanish football will pay tribute to Jesús de Miguel, who died in the Urda train crash. A minute of silence and applause will take place at every stadium this matchday.
stories.body: FC Barcelona posted that the federation, La Liga and Liga F, together with clubs and players, will dedicate the round to his memory. Barça will be represented at the official act in Tenerife by Asensi and Dani Olmo. The tribute follows the minute of silence held before the Aston Villa match at Camp Nou. The crash killed several people, including the CD Tenerife supporter. Matches this weekend, including Atlético versus Barcelona, will include the gesture.

tweets.name: FC Barcelona
tweets.text: Always in our memory. Spanish football comes together to pay tribute to Jesús de Miguel.

stories.headline: Sunday’s Metropolitano clash decides top of La Liga
stories.summary: Barcelona travel to the Metropolitano on 8 November at 21:00. The side lead by two points. Atlético are second. Real Madrid sit three points further back.
stories.body: Rodri is ruled out with a minor right hamstring injury. Several senior defenders remain unavailable, including Eric García, Jules Koundé, Xavi Espart and Andreas Christensen. Flick has used Brian Fariñas and Gerard Martín in recent matches. After this fixture the international break begins. Players will report to national teams from 9 November. Barça next host Villarreal on 22 November. The Champions League continues on 25 November away to Sabah in Baku.
